DIMO Maint

Scalable CMMS solutions for all business sizes.

Founded 1995
Pricing Model Subscription

Overview

DIMO Maint offers a range of CMMS solutions designed to scale with a business. It is highly interoperable with major ERP systems (like Sage and Microsoft Dynamics) and provides robust tools for managing industrial and facility maintenance.
